title: Messi Expected in Argentina's 55-Man Preliminary World Cup Squad — Scaloni to Submit to FIFA by May 11
detail: Argentina head coach Lionel Scaloni is expected to name Lionel Messi in the preliminary 55-man World Cup squad due to FIFA by May 11, as confirmed by multiple reports from World Soccer Talk and ESPN. At 38, Messi is among 21 players considered certainties in Scaloni's squad, alongside Emiliano 'Dibu' Martínez, Lautaro Martínez, Julián Álvarez, and Lisandro Martínez. Scaloni has consistently said the final decision on Messi's participation rests 'entirely with him' — Messi has expressed a desire to play but has not formally confirmed. The preliminary squad is a staging ground: Scaloni has until June 1 to submit the final 26-man roster to FIFA. Adidas previously unveiled 'El Último Tango' (The Last Tango) signature F50 boots in white, sky blue, and gold — widely interpreted as Messi's World Cup farewell footwear. Argentina are in Group J alongside Algeria, Austria, and Jordan, with all three group-stage matches scheduled at Arrowhead Stadium in Kansas City.

media.caption: Messi expected in Argentina's 55-man preliminary World Cup squad due May 11 — Scaloni says the final call rests entirely with the 38-year-old captain

title: USMNT Roster Announcement Confirmed for May 26 in New York City — Pochettino Finalizing 26-Man Panel
detail: Fox Sports and CBS Sports confirmed that USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino will reveal the official 26-man World Cup squad on May 26 in a live televised event in New York City, broadcast on FOX from 3–4 p.m. ET. Pochettino must also submit a preliminary expanded list of 35–55 players to FIFA by May 11 — eight days away. CBS Sports published a comprehensive roster projection identifying Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), Weston McKennie (Juventus), Tyler Adams, and Chris Richards as near-certain inclusions. The elimination of Patrick Agyemang (ruptured Achilles) has created an opening in the attacking third. Pochettino's biggest calls are expected in the center-forward position and in the defensive midfield, where competition is intense among the pool of players in form at their clubs. The USMNT's next match before the tournament is May 31 vs. Senegal — five days after the roster announcement — giving Pochettino a final competitive test with his selected group before the June 11 opening.

media.caption: USMNT roster announcement confirmed for May 26 — Pochettino must submit preliminary squad to FIFA by May 11 as projection debates intensify over the final attacking spots
